articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Valuations Fuel VC Fears of Startup Correction
articles.summary: In late September, OpenAI entered discussions for its latest funding round with confidence. After having early discussions with prospective backers who had expressed interest, the company presented its terms: at least $30 billion in new capital at a $1.4 trillion valuation.Few startups have been as successful at fundraising as OpenAI, which was last valued at $852 billion. articles.title: What Taiwanese chip giant TSMC gains from taking stakes in OpenAI and Anthropic’s AI race
articles.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company’s (TSMC) move to take equity stakes in both OpenAI and Anthropic will give the world’s largest contract chipmaker direct financial ties to the frontier AI labs driving demand for its business. Its board on Tuesday authorised up to US$500 million to buy Anthropic common shares at its initial public offering (IPO) price, and up to US$500 million to buy preferred shares in OpenAI. articles.title: Anthropic IPO Is ‘Jenga Block’ Holding Up Next Leg of AI Trade
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC’s long-awaited initial public offering will give investors a crucial look at the health of the artificial intelligence trade, and Wall Street hopes it will spur the next leg of the AI-fueled stock market rally that’s going on four years.

articles.title: Nvidia Working With Outside Firm to Identify CEO Candidates
articles.summary: Nvidia Corp.’s board has been working with an outside firm to identify potential replacements for Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang following reports of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a woman who is reportedly suspected of spying for China, a person familiar with the situation said.

articles.title: ‘Web of complexity’: Jensen Huang’s position in doubt as Nvidia shares plunge overnight
articles.summary: Nvidia shares fell more than 8 per cent at one point in US after-hours trading on Wednesday as CEO Jensen Huang’s prospects of hanging onto his role became more clouded after media reports of a board meeting and another extramarital affair. The drop in the American AI chip giant’s share price erased a 2.9 per cent rebound in the regular trading session, after the stock lost over 9.5 per cent in trading on Monday and Tuesday. articles.title: Anthropic IPO Risks Causing AI Correction, Selby Says
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster initial public offering may become the catalyst for major reversal in the artificial intelligence trade, according to Jack Selby, who runs the venture capital firm Copper Sky.

articles.title: Nvidia Preparing to Oust Jensen Huang After Affairs, WSJ Says
articles.summary: Nvidia Corp.’s board is preparing to oust Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang after multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a woman who is reportedly suspected of being a Chinese spy, the Wall Street Journal said Wednesday.
